frame_row: Complete direct-child composition of the implemented AXI cluster core. Internal D-cache coherence is inside the CPU tile array; external memory and MMIO use AXI interfaces.

label: u_vlsit_axi_llc
(m_vlsit_axi_llc)
blocks.function: Wrap the licensed native LLC with VLSIT AXI/service/maintenance and fault-event ports.

label: u_vlsit_axil_reg_bridge
(m_vlsit_axil_reg_bridge)
blocks.function: Translate AXI4-Lite LLC-service accesses into the pinned PULP RegBus request/response form.

label: u_vlsit_cpucl_csr
(m_vlsit_cpucl_csr)
blocks.function: Implement workbook-defined AXI4-Lite PMU controls, snapshot words, IRQ/diagnostic status and read-only fatal records.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_axi_mem_mux
(m_vlsit_riscv_axi_mem_mux)
blocks.function: Arbitrate per-hart memory traffic while preserving source identity and response routing.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_axi_mmio
(m_vlsit_riscv_axi_mmio)
blocks.function: Provide a separate non-coherent AXI4 device egress for active harts.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_axi_route
(m_vlsit_riscv_axi_route)
blocks.function: Classify and route one hart slot to cacheable memory, normal-uncached bypass, device MMIO or a local error response. Four generated slots are indexed 0 to 3; two- and four-hart builds activate the configured slots.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_axil_decode
(m_vlsit_riscv_axil_decode)
blocks.function: Decode one external AXI4-Lite control port into cluster CSR and LLC service targets.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_cmo_arbiter
(m_vlsit_riscv_cmo_arbiter)
blocks.function: Select one hart's retirement-blocking maintenance request and preserve its completion destination.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_cmo_controller
(m_vlsit_riscv_cmo_controller)
blocks.function: Sequence CCU preparation, optional per-line LLC maintenance, terminal COMMIT/ABORT and the hart completion response.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_cpu_tile_array
(m_vlsit_riscv_cpu_tile_array)
blocks.function: Replicate two or four active CVA6 tiles; coordinate the internal MESI D-cache directory, tagged probes, address classification, maintenance retirement and event capture.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_fault_record
(m_vlsit_riscv_fault_record)
blocks.function: Capture the first fatal ordinary L1 or shared LLC writeback error until reset.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_pmu
(m_vlsit_riscv_pmu)
blocks.function: Integrate source event packing, scope selection, counters, atomic snapshots and aggregate overflow interrupt.

legend_note: All 12 direct child instances of m_vlsit_riscv_cluster_core are shown. The top row shows the per-hart AXI route, normal-memory mux and LLC; the middle row shows device egress, maintenance control and LLC service bridge; the bottom row shows PMU, fault record and AXI4-Lite control. Arrows show primary data/control paths and the fault-record CSR path. For legibility, secondary PMU event-source and LLC/L1 fault-source bundles are detailed in HDS Sections 6 and 14 and are not separate arrows here. The route generates four hart slots indexed 0..3; PARA_CPU_NUM activates two or four. Nested CVA6/HPDcache/MESI and internal CCU hierarchy is expanded in Section 14 component diagrams. Signal names and block provenance for shown paths are listed on BLOCK_INFORMATION. Responses return on the same protocol bundle.
